- [Microsoft Clarity MCP Server](https://github.com/microsoft/clarity-mcp-server) - Microsoft Clarity MCP Server enables AI agents and LLMs to access Microsoft Clarity's website analytics data export API through the Model Context Protocol. Ideal for AI-driven UX analysis and optimization use cases; it provides conversational access superior to raw API calls or tools like Google Analytics integrations.
